caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl with a wide rim, rendered in shades of orange and brown. The bowl is decorated with triangular and circular patterns featuring a combination of earthy tones and accents of green and white. There are swooping, vine-like green lines interwoven through some of the patterns, as well as leaf or branch designs in a darker brown. In the center of the bowl, there is a design consisting of a curved brown form with a central green wavy line and a lighter beige outline. The background is a plain, light beige surface, and there is a shadow beneath the bowl, suggesting it is resting on a flat surface.
title: Pa. German Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
